messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: Can you summarize the services provided by the Causeway VA Clinic?\nassistant: The Causeway VA Clinic, located in downtown Boston, provides primary care and specialty services including mental health, laboratory services, and more. It offers quick and convenient primary care appointments, for urgent conditions same-day or next-day appointments in primary care are available. The clinic offers laboratory and pathology services  including: the study of blood, urine and other bodily fluids for illness management and testing for infectious diseases. Mental health care for common conditions such as addiction, depression, anxiety, trauma, PTSD, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, and OCD. The mental health care services include individual and group therapy for psychiatric disorders and marriage and relationship problems. Inpatient care is available for Veterans in need of intensive treatment. We also offer telehealth visits with providers in specialties such as: Mental health, Retinal care (eye), Bariatric surgery (visit remotely with your weight-loss surgery team before and after your operation), Dermatology, Rehabilitation and Primary care.\nuser: Are there any other VA clinics in Boston?\nassistant: Yes, there is another VA clinic in Boston called the Jamaica Plain VA Outpatient Clinic. It is located at 150 South Huntington Avenue, Jamaica Plain, MA 02130. This clinic provides primary care, mental health care, and specialty services. \nuser: Is this the Clinic that can help with stuttering and problems swallowing?\nassistant: The Jamaica Plain VA Outpatient Clinic provides services  that help with speech, language, fluency, voice, cognitive communication, swallowing, stuttering, and laryngectomy (surgical removal of the larynx, which contains your vocal cords).\nuser: Are these clinics available 24/7 for emergencies?",
    "answer": "文档没有说明这些诊所是否全天候开放。它只说明退伍军人可随时前往 West Roxbury 院区的急诊室（24/7）；紧急心理健康服务则是在正常营业时间提供。"
}
Output:

statements: 文档没有说明 Causeway VA Clinic 和 Jamaica Plain VA Outpatient Clinic 是否全天候开放。
文档说明退伍军人可随时前往 West Roxbury 院区的急诊室。
West Roxbury 院区的急诊室每周七天、每天二十四小时开放。
文档说明紧急心理健康服务在正常营业时间提供。
